title: [Bug] Worktree creation hangs with complex branch names containing hyphens
body:
**Bug Description**
Worktree branching with "complex" name no longer working.

My workflow is to copy linear branch names and create worktrees from them. This worked until around the 19th/20th. When I attempt to create a worktree from the branch name, it stalls indefinitely.

myname/projectname-1235-i-am-working-on-this-feature for example.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.1.81
- Feedback ID: 9ef7460a-4882-4a2d-a1f7-4a52e66ff591

**Errors**
